name: Radico Khaitan Ltd
about: Incorporated in the year 1943, Radico Khaitan is one of the most recognised IMFL (Indian Made Foreign Liquor) brands in India. [1]The company was initially known as Rampur Distillery Company and was focussed on distillation and bottling for branded players  and canteen stores of armed forces. Later on in  the year 1997, Radico Khaitan  ventured into its own branded IMFL products and launched its first brand  8PM whisky which became its millionarie brand within a year of its launch. [2]
keyPoints:
Market Leadership
The company is one of the oldest and largest manufacturers of Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL), a leading supplier of branded IMFL to the Canteen Stores Department (CSD) in India, and the country's oldest and largest malt distiller. [1] It is also one of the largest exporters of Alcoholic beverages from India to 102+ countries. [2]

cons: Stock is trading at 15.1 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of 11.7% over last 3 years.
